messages:
incident-bot: Page (P1) -> @oncall: Canary error spike after deploy v2.3.8. 5xx rate 18% in eu-west-1, latency 2.1s. Auto-escalating.

dev-deploy-bot: Deploy started: v2.3.8 (commit abc1234) -> canary to 5% traffic in eu-west-1.

jordan: seeing alerts, looking now. probably a model serving change?

samir: grabbing logs from the canary nodes. tailing /var/log/runtime/serving.log - seeing OOM-ish lines + "kv cache null ptr" errors.

lee: @jordan can you confirm which change in abc1234 touched KV cache path?

jordan: abc1234 rolled an optimization that changes kv cache eviction timing. suspecting race on cold k-v.

maya: I'm 2nd oncall, jumping in. If canary is 18% 5xx we should throttle or rollback. Suggest feature-flag kill-switch for canary path first.

olivia: Flag 'kv-cache-new-policy' is live. I can toggle it. Want a kill?

jordan: Kill it. Turn off the flag for eu-west-1 canary.

olivia: toggling -> /flags/kv-cache-new-policy: OFF for eu-west-1. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: Metric check: 5xx reduced from 18% -> 12% in 60s. Latency still elevated.

samir: still seeing exceptions but much fewer. I think partial mitigation. but we should revert the commit entirely from canary.

dev-deploy-bot: Command executed: rdeploy rollback --target canary --commit abc1234 --initiator jordan

dev-deploy-bot: Rollback complete for canary (v2.3.7). Canary traffic now not receiving abc1234.

incident-bot: Update: severity remains P1 until full rollback to stable and 5xx < 1%. Paging timeline attached.

jordan: Performing a quick hotfix plan: 1) revert commit abc1234 on canary, 2) prepare small patch removing risky eviction tweak, 3) test, 4) promote. Who owns the hotfix?

samir: I'll craft the patch. can do small revert + add guard condition. Expect PR in ~25m.

maya: I'll coordinate customer impact and comms. @support please hold off on customer outbound until we have root cause and ETA.

olivia: Monitoring shows 5xx at 0.4% now, stable for 2 minutes. Good candidate to de-escalate but keep oncall.

dev-deploy-bot: New PR created: PR #482 - revert(eviction-timing) by samir -> includes guard + extra unit tests. CI queued.

qa-bot: CI passed for unit tests, running integration tests (small cluster). Estimated 7m.

jordan: If CI passes, let's do a hotfix canary deploy to 2 nodes in eu-west-1 first. Use deploy tag hotfix-abc1234-revert.

dev-deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy: hotfix-abc1234-revert -> 2 nodes in eu-west-1.

qa-bot: Integration tests passed on hotfix canary. Running load test ramp x2 for 3 minutes.

lee: Observability: spikes cleared. 5xx at 0.02%, p95 latency down to baseline. Logs no kv errors.

maya: Good. Prepare rollback plan in case of regression and communicate to ops.

olivia: Promoting hotfix now to 30% traffic in eu-west-1 canary.

dev-deploy-bot: Promoted to 30% canary -> hotfix-abc1234-revert.

incident-bot: Customer impact assessment: Hosted API eu-west-1 5xx peaked at 18% for ~8 minutes, average customer request failure across active tenants ~2% between 15:03 and 15:38 UTC. No data exfiltration, no config drift.

maya: Opening incident ticket INF-2025-0916 with summary and preliminary impact.

jordan: After hotfix at 15:30 UTC, metrics normal. Plan: 1) full promote to 100% in eu-west-1, 2) schedule postmortem and RCA, 3) follow-up with customers impacted.

samir: full promote initiated: deploy promote --tag hotfix-abc1234-revert --region eu-west-1 --to 100%

dev-deploy-bot: Promote complete. Production at 100% hotfix-abc1234-revert.

qa-bot: Synthetic checks green across regions.

maya: Handing off the incident to post-incident owner for RCA: @olivia you'll own timeline and comms, @samir will own code RCA, @jordan will write mitigation section. Handoff at 15:45 UTC.

olivia: Ack. Scheduling a 60-min RCA meeting for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll draft a short customer note for support to use.

jordan: Quick notes to include in RCA: root cause = regression in kv cache eviction timing introduced in abc1234 -> race under certain trace lengths; trigger = canary rollout to traffic pattern with cold cache; mitigation = feature flag kill-switch + hotfix revert + added guards + extra tests; action items include adding synthetic canary that stresses cold-kv path and blocking similar cache changes without perf gate.

maya: I'll run impact analysis and attach tenant list for support. initial estimate: ~12 customers saw increased errors briefly; 3 customers with heavy real-time inference likely to have user-visible failures.

samir: I'll open PR for increased unit/integration coverage and a risk checklist for future cache changes.

lee: Postmortem owners assigned. Closing incident channel after postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:

olivia: Thanks everyone. Great rapid response.

jordan: big thanks. We'll follow up in INF-2025-0916 and the RCA meeting. :rocket:
